author: regional.director@example.com
subject: This is unacceptable
body: I am furious. This is the third TGX-9 outage this quarter and the last report had the wrong tables. North Ridge lost data for four hours and nobody escalated. I want a corrected aggregated report by Friday with every event in order and nothing dropped.

author: carrier.noc@example.com
subject: Re: outage window confirmation
body: We reviewed our logs for 2026-03-02 between 02:00 and 07:00 local and found no upstream faults on our side during that window. The problem appears to be on the gateway.

author: qa_reviewer
subject: table correctness
body: The timeline table in the previous generation merged two sites into one row. That is wrong. Each event needs its own row with the correct source document.

author: field_tech_interview
subject: verbal account from site visit
body: Technician confirmed the cabinet fan was audibly struggling before the event and that a power cycle has become a routine workaround at three sites. This was never written down until now.

author: reliability_lead
subject: firmware version correction
body: Please note firmware 4.2.1 is the affected version, not 4.2.0 as stated in an earlier draft. Sites on 4.1.8 were not affected.
